title: PairConfirmResponse
description: Canonical v1 response to POST /api/v1/pair/confirm. token is an opaque string; refresh_token is optional.

token.description: Opaque bearer token issued for the paired device

refresh_token.description: Opaque refresh token, present when the server supports token refresh

expires_in.description: Token lifetime in seconds. 0 means no automatic expiry: valid until revocation or factory reset (receiver-issued tokens).

device_id.description: Stable identifier assigned to the paired device

server_id.description: Stable identifier of the server that issued the token
